observations: Function `collect` takes `item` and a default `bucket=[]` mutable default argument.
Body appends `item` to `bucket` and returns the same `bucket` object.
The stated behavior contract expects each omitted-bucket call to receive a fresh bucket.
Mutable default arguments are evaluated once at function definition, so the default list is shared across calls that omit `bucket`.
Probe p1 calls `collect(1)` then `collect(2)` without a bucket and returns snapshots, which would expose shared state if the default is reused.
Probe p2 passes an explicit list `[9]`, which is mutated in place and returned, matching the explicit-bucket part of the contract.
